articles.title: Man stabbed at Mississauga bus terminal, woman in custody
articles.summary: A man was stabbed following an altercation with a woman at Mississauga’s local bus terminal on Friday evening, according to Peel Regional Police. articles.summary: A 12-year-old boy was rushed to a hospital on Friday evening after getting hit by a car in the Lawrence Park neighbourhood. articles.title: Toronto man, 34, accused of breaking into multiple Weston-area homes is charged
articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested and charged a man who is accused of breaking into multiple homes in the Weston area. Police allege that 34-year-old Austin MacDonald broke into a garage near Jane and Church Streets on Aug. 26 and stole two dirt bikes. articles.title: Toronto man, 25, wanted in Etobicoke sex assault investigation
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for a man who is wanted in connection with a sexual assault investigation near Dundas and Bloor Streets in Etobicoke. articles.summary: The Peel Regional Police Service confirms to CityNews that it has opened an investigation after Mississauga mayoral candidate Bonnie Crombie came forward saying online threats were made against her. articles.title: 16-year-old charged with manufacturing firearm parts, threatening Pickering school
articles.summary: Police say a 16-year-old boy is facing charges after allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Pickering, Ont., high school and making firearm parts with a 3D printer.

articles.title: Man, 35, dead after hit and run in Scarborough, police say
articles.summary: A 35-year-old man is dead after a hit and run in Scarborough early Friday, police say.

articles.title: The battle between Mississauga's current and ex mayor
articles.summary: Mississauga’s current and former mayors are at odds, and the political fallout is making waves. CBC's Chris Glover speaks with two guests to analyze the high-stakes dynamic between Carolyn Parrish and Bonnie Crombie. Tune in to hear what’s driving this rivalry and what it means for local voter turnout.

articles.title: Rogers becomes sole owner of MLSE after purchasing remaining 25% stake
articles.summary: Rogers Communications Inc. says it has completed its purchase of the remaining 25 per cent stake in Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment from Larry Tanenbaum's Kilmer Sports Inc.
